Name:      llvm

Summary:   The LLVM Project is a collection of modular and reusable compiler and toolchain technologies

Release:   1
Group:     Development/Toolchain

Patch0:     0001-Add-support-for-Tizen-toolchain-vendor.patch
Patch1:     0002-Link-libclang_rt.asan.so-against-libatomic-when-nece.patch
Patch2:     0003-Fix-armv7l-build-when-compiler-is-clang.patch
Patch3:     0004-clang-add-support-for-LLVM-gold-plugin-in-case-of-ac.patch
Patch4:     0005-Merge-MLGO-AOT-compilation-support-and-optimization-.patch
Patch5:     0006-libcxxabi-declare-__gnu_unwind_frame-in-cxa_personal.patch
Patch6:     0007-libcxx-backport-EH-ABI-forced-unwind-handling.patch
Patch7:     0008-cmake-use-hybrid-LLVM-linkage-on-x86_64.patch








BuildRequires: cmake
BuildRequires: python3
BuildRequires: python3-devel
BuildRequires: patchelf
BuildRequires: binutils-devel
BuildRequires: libxml2-devel



BuildRequires: ninja









Requires: libllvm = 22.1.8-1

%description
LLVM is a compiler infrastructure designed for compile-time, link-time, runtime,
and idle-time optimization of programs from arbitrary programming languages.
LLVM is written in C++ and has been developed since 2000 at the University of
Illinois and Apple. It currently supports compilation of C and C++ programs,
using front-ends derived from GCC 4.0.1. A new front-end for the C family of
languages is in development. The compiler infrastructure
includes mirror sets of programming tools as well as libraries with equivalent
functionality.

%package devel
Summary: Libraries and Header Files for LLVM 22.1.8
Requires: llvm = 22.1.8

%description devel
This package contains library and header files needed to develop
new native programs that use the LLVM infrastructure.

%package static-devel
Summary: Static libraries for LLVM
Requires: llvm = 22.1.8

%description static-devel
This package contains static libraries needed to develop new
native programs that use the LLVM infrastructure.

%package -n libllvm
Summary: LLVM shared libraries

%description -n libllvm
Shared libraries for the LLVM compiler infrastructure.

%package -n clang
Summary: Clang 22.1.8 (C Language family frontend for LLVM)
License: NCSA
Requires: llvm = 22.1.8-1
Provides: libclang.so.22.1.8

%description -n clang
A new front-end for the C family of languages is in development.

%package -n clang-devel
Summary: Clang 22.1.8 Development Library
Requires: clang = 22.1.8-1

%description -n clang-devel
This package contains the clang (C language) frontend for LLVM.
(development files)

%package -n lldb
Summary: LLDB
License: NCSA

%description -n lldb
LLDB is a next generation, high-performance debugger. It is built as a set
of reusable components which highly leverage existing libraries in the
larger LLVM Project, such as the Clang expression parser and LLVM
disassembler.

%package -n lldb-devel
Summary: Development header files for LLDB
Requires: lldb = 22.1.8-1

%description -n lldb-devel
The package contains header files for the LLDB debugger.

%package -n compiler-rt
Summary: Compiler runtime libraries

%description -n compiler-rt
Compiler runtime libraries

%package -n libomp
Summary:    OpenMP runtime

%description -n libomp
OpenMP runtime.

%package -n libomp-devel
Summary:    Development files for the OpenMP runtime

%description -n libomp-devel
Development files for the OpenMP runtime.

%package -n python-clang
Summary: Python bindings to parts of the Clang library

%description -n python-clang
Python bindings to parts of the Clang library

%prep
%setup -q
# 0001-Add-support-for-Tizen-toolchain-vendor.patch
%patch -P 0 -p1
# 0002-Link-libclang_rt.asan.so-against-libatomic-when-nece.patch
%patch -P 1 -p1
# 0003-Fix-armv7l-build-when-compiler-is-clang.patch
%patch -P 2 -p1
# 0004-clang-add-support-for-LLVM-gold-plugin-in-case-of-ac.patch
%patch -P 3 -p1
# 0005-Merge-MLGO-AOT-compilation-support-and-optimization-.patch
%patch -P 4 -p1
# 0006-libcxxabi-declare-__gnu_unwind_frame-in-cxa_personal.patch
%patch -P 5 -p1
# 0007-libcxx-backport-EH-ABI-forced-unwind-handling.patch
%patch -P 6 -p1
# 0008-cmake-use-hybrid-LLVM-linkage-on-x86_64.patch
%patch -P 7 -p1
mkdir -p mlgo_verify_assets
tar -C mlgo_verify_assets -xzf /usr/src/packages/SOURCES/mlgo_aarch_model.tar.gz

%build
export AR=%{__ar_1} RANLIB=%{__ranlib_1};
export CC=%{__cc_1} CXX=%{__cxx_1};


cp /usr/src/packages/SOURCES/llvm.manifest .




# Set up MLGO AOT model paths from bundled verify assets
MLGO_AOT_DIR="$PWD/mlgo_verify_assets"
MLGO_BUILD_DIR="$PWD/build"
MLGO_RUNTIME_OBJECTS="${MLGO_AOT_DIR}/xla_runtime_objects/xla_compiled_cpu_function.cc.o;${MLGO_AOT_DIR}/xla_runtime_objects/cpu_function_runtime.cc.o;${MLGO_AOT_DIR}/xla_runtime_objects/custom_call_status.cc.o;${MLGO_AOT_DIR}/xla_runtime_objects/executable_run_options.cc.o;${MLGO_AOT_DIR}/xla_runtime_objects/runtime_single_threaded_matmul_f32.cc.o"
MLGO_REQUIRED_RUNTIME_OBJECTS="xla_compiled_cpu_function.cc.o cpu_function_runtime.cc.o custom_call_status.cc.o executable_run_options.cc.o runtime_single_threaded_matmul_f32.cc.o"

mkdir -p build
cd build
cmake \
    -G Ninja \
    -DTIZEN=1 \
    -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=%{__cc_1} \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=%{__cxx_1} \
    -DLLVM_HOST_TRIPLE=x86_64-tizen-linux-gnu \
    -DLLVM_DEFAULT_TARGET_TRIPLE=x86_64-tizen-linux-gnu \
    -DLLVM_TARGET_TRIPLE_ENV=x86_64-tizen-linux-gnu \
    -DCMAKE_ASM_FLAGS="$CFLAGS" \
    -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="$CFLAGS" \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="$CXXFLAGS" \
    -DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-fuse-ld=lld -flto=thin -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wl,--gc-sections" \
    -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fuse-ld=lld -flto=thin -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wl,--gc-sections" \
    -DLLVM_USE_LINKER=lld \
    -DLLVM_ENABLE_LTO=Thin \
    -DCMAKE_RANLIB=/usr/bin/llvm-ranlib \
    -DCMAKE_AR=/usr/bin/llvm-ar \
    -DLLVM_ENABLE_ASSERTIONS=No \
    -DLLVM_ENABLE_RTTI=ON \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
    -DLLVM_TARGETS_TO_BUILD='AArch64;BPF' \
    -DLLVM_TARGET_ARCH="AArch64" \
    -DCLANG_ENABLE_ARCMT=OFF \
    -DLLVM_BUILD_LLVM_DYLIB=ON \
    -DCLANG_BUILD_CLANG_DYLIB=ON \
    -DLLVM_LINK_LLVM_DYLIB=ON \
    -DCLANG_LINK_CLANG_DYLIB=ON \
    -DLLVM_ENABLE_PROJECTS="clang;lldb;clang-tools-extra;lld;compiler-rt;openmp" \
    -DLLVM_ENABLE_PER_TARGET_RUNTIME_DIR=OFF \
    -DLLVM_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \
    -DLLVM_INCLUDE_EXAMPLES=OFF \
    -DLLVM_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
    -DLLVM_INCLUDE_TESTS=OFF \
    -DLLVM_ENABLE_DOXYGEN=OFF \
    -DLLVM_BUILD_DOCS=OFF \
    -DLLVM_INCLUDE_DOCS=OFF \
    -DLLVM_OPTIMIZED_TABLEGEN=ON \
    -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \
    -DLLVM_LIBDIR_SUFFIX=`echo lib64 | sed s/lib//g` \
    -DCLANG_RESOURCE_DIR="../lib64/clang/22" \
    -DLLVM_BINUTILS_INCDIR=/usr/include \
    -DLLVM_PARALLEL_COMPILE_JOBS=6 \
    -DLLVM_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS=2 \
    -DTENSORFLOW_AOT_PATH="${MLGO_AOT_DIR}/mlgo_sysroot" \
    -DLLVM_MLGO_EXPORT_TF_XLA_RUNTIME=OFF \
    -DLLVM_MLGO_EMBED_TF_XLA_RUNTIME_OBJECTS="${MLGO_RUNTIME_OBJECTS}" \
    -DLLVM_OVERRIDE_MODEL_HEADER_INLINERSIZEMODEL="${MLGO_AOT_DIR}/InlinerSizeModel.h" \
    -DLLVM_OVERRIDE_MODEL_OBJECT_INLINERSIZEMODEL="${MLGO_AOT_DIR}/InlinerSizeModel.o" \
    -DLLVM_OVERRIDE_MODEL_HEADER_REGALLOCEVICTMODEL="${MLGO_AOT_DIR}/RegAllocEvictModel.h" \
    -DLLVM_OVERRIDE_MODEL_OBJECT_REGALLOCEVICTMODEL="${MLGO_AOT_DIR}/RegAllocEvictModel.o" \
    ../llvm


# Full build using ninja (already in build/ directory after cd build)
ninja -j 6


%install
export AR=%{__ar_1} RANLIB=%{__ranlib_1};
export CC=%{__cc_1} CXX=%{__cxx_1};

cd build
cmake -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr -P cmake_install.cmake
ln -sf /usr/bin/clang++ /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr/bin/clang++-22

ln -sf clang /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr/bin/x86_64-tizen-linux-gnu-clang
ln -sf clang++ /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr/bin/x86_64-tizen-linux-gnu-clang++
# Use host triple and resource dir by default via <lang>.cfg
cat >> /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64//usr/bin/clang.cfg << EOF
-target x86_64-tizen-linux-gnu
-resource-dir /usr/lib64/clang/22
EOF
ln -sf clang.cfg /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64//usr/bin/clang++.cfg

# copy lldb for sdk
mkdir -p /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/lldb/bin
mkdir -p /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/lldb/lib64

mv /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr/bin/lldb /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/lldb/bin
mv /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr/bin/lldb-argdumper /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/lldb/bin
mv /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr/bin/lldb-server /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/lldb/bin

ln -sf /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/lldb/bin/lldb /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr/bin/

cp -P /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr/lib64/liblldb.so* /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/lldb/lib64/

# Install the clang python bits
mkdir -p /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages
cp -a ../clang/bindings/python/clang /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/

rm -rf /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr/lib64/debug/*
rm -rf /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr/lib/libear/*
rm -rf /usr/src/packages/BUILDROOT/llvm-22.1.8-1.aarch64/usr/lib/libscanbuild/*


%post -n clang -p /sbin/ldconfig
%postun -n clang -p /sbin/ldconfig

%post -n lldb
echo "plugin load /usr/share/dotnet.tizen/netcoreapp/SOS/libsosplugin.so" > /root/.lldbinit
